definitions.gloss: world of difference; vast gap; enormous disparity
definitions.explanation: An extremely large difference between two things, likened to the distance between clouds and mud — the highest and lowest things imaginable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a world of difference in ability between the two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a vast difference between last year's and this year's results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a world of difference in taste between a homemade cake and a store-bought one.

notes:
An idiomatic expression combining {雲|うん} (clouds) and {泥|でい} (mud) — the most distant extremes — with ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference). The image is that two things are as far apart as the sky and the ground.

ETYMOLOGY:
From classical Chinese, comparing the distance between clouds (the highest) and mud (the lowest). The standalone compound {雲泥|うんでい} already means "vast difference," and adding ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ makes this explicit.

USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{雲泥|うんでい}の{差|さ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is a world of difference in ~). Can describe positive or negative comparisons.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{地|ち}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ — difference as great as heaven and earth (similar meaning)
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧すっぽん — comparing the moon and a snapping turtle (two things that look similar but are vastly different in quality)
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ — big difference (plain, non-idiomatic)
